caption: The drawing depicts a clear glass dome with a black base, containing a glass vase filled with an arrangement of colorful artificial flowers and leaves. The flowers are red, white, purple, and blue, with green stems and leaves, and some beige or yellowish elements. At the base of the vase, inside the dome, are additional green leaves and pink and blue floral decorations. The background is a plain off-white color. In the upper left and right corners of the drawing, there are two inset boxes: the left box shows a green and beige plant with five arms, while the right box displays isolated flower parts, including a full red and a yellow flower, a flower bud, and a green stem. The overall composition centers on the dome and vase with floral elements, with the inset illustrations providing botanical details.
title: Wool Flowers Under Glass
